tables.heading: Squad abilities
rows: Limits the number of troops that can be hit by a single splash attack. If a source of splash damage hits more troops than the limit allows, the remainder will be made invincible to the damage.
Barch Squad, Giant Wizard Squad, Minion Squad, Golem Witch Squad

All members of the squad will be invisible for a short period after deployment. Invisibility works on a per-troop basis, so troops that are deployed later will still gain invisibility for the full duration.
All members of the squad take less damage from Traps. This stacks multiplicatively with other damage reduction effects.
Balloon Squad, Hog Rider Squad, Miner Squad

All members of the squad will be invincible for a short period after deployment. Invincibility works on a per-troop basis, so troops that are deployed later will still gain invincibility for the full duration.
All members of the squad will attack the same target, where possible.
All members of the squad do not lose their Tantrum abilities if the only air units around them are each other.

units.note: A squad gains its ability when upgraded to level 2, which needs Laboratory 17 (TH 19). The wiki names the squad for 3 of the 6 abilities so far; the rest come from Judo Sloth Gaming, "Every Squad Explained in Clash of Clans!" (YouTube, Nov 2026).
units.progressionNote: Abilities unlock at squad level 2, from Laboratory 17 (TH 19), and improve at level 3. Most costs and times haven't been revealed yet.

note: The Town Hall 19 update (Nov 16, 2026) from the wiki, read Nov 17, 2026. The wiki is still being updated for the release, so some values may change. TBA = not on the wiki yet. Squads deploy a fixed group of troops in a set formation, using less housing space than the same troops trained one by one. Squad troops use your own researched troop levels, and squads can't be donated. Each Squad Barracks level (Army Buildings, from TH 8) unlocks one squad; training is free and instant. From Laboratory 17 (TH 19) squads can be upgraded to level 2 and up, which unlocks their squad ability; squads go up to level 3. Troop counts, housing space and ability levels come from a Supercell creator's video until the wiki lists them; most upgrade costs haven't been shown yet.
